note: What a server sends to change something about a prop already on the map. The kind of change is named inside it, and the fields around the kind keep one layout whatever it is. The header names no object: it carries zero.

fields.name: name
fields.note: The name the change loads, such as a set of movements the prop plays. Written out in full and padded with zero bytes to the width above.

fields.name: startsAt
fields.note: When the change begins, in milliseconds of match time.

fields.name: lasts
fields.note: How long the change runs, in seconds.

fields.name: prop
fields.note: The prop changed, by the name MapProp gave it.

fields.name: flags
fields.note: How the change is made. The bits within are undetermined; a server sends 1 or 2.

fields.name: kind
fields.note: What sort of change it is. A server sends 1; what other kinds carry is undetermined.
